description: Office of the Cabinet of Ministers - Order to appoint Secretaries to the Ministries (Internal Trade, Housing)
categorisation: This gazette contains ONLY government personnel changes (appointments of named individuals as Secretaries to State Ministries) with basic titles only ("Secretary to the State Ministry of..."). It does NOT include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas that these individuals will oversee, which would be required for a Hybrid (Type 3) classification.
